#summary Tutorial how to install the EMF Client Platform

  # Install an [http://phoenix.eclipse.org/packages/ Eclipse Modeling Edition]
  # Install the current release of the EMF Client Platform
  * Add Update Site to your Eclipse: Help => Install new Software => Add Update Site
  * Enter EMF Client Platform Update Site: [http://unicase.googlecode.com/svn/updatesite/ecpNightly http://unicase.googlecode.com/svn/updatesite/ecpNightly]
  * Important: Uncheck "Group Items by Category" and "Contact all update sites ..."
  * Select all Features from the update site and install

Links to required resources:
  * [http://phoenix.eclipse.org/packages/ Eclipse Modeling Edition Download]
  * [ECPDownloads EMFCP Update Site]
  * [http://unicase.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/documentation/tutorials/emfcp/exampleModel.zip Example Model Plugins for ECP]
